Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.question: Abu Yusuf promptly returned to the south, defeated the forces of _____ and entered Marrakesh on 8 September 1269, putting a final end to the Almohad Caliphate
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: But once Abu Dabbus seized Marrakesh in 1266, he broke his treaty with the Marinids and refused to pass Marrakesh over to them. Instead, Abu Dabbus persuaded the Abdalwadid ruler Yaghmorassan of the Kingdom of Tlemcen to launch an incursion into Marinid land from the northeast.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subject: Indian Languages
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subSubject: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.question: The Draa valley Arabs submitted only after a campaign in 1271, and _____ only in 1274
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: The Marinids had some difficulty getting their authority recognized by the southerly Maqil Arabs of the Draa valley and Sijilmassa. The Draa valley Arabs submitted only after a campaign in 1271, and Sijilmassa only in 1274.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subject: Indian Languages
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subSubject: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.question: In 1274, _____ I's son and successor, Muhammad II al-Faqih struck a deal with Alfonso X, paying the Castilian king some 300,000 maravedis and promising not to intrigue with Castilian rebels
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: In 1274, Muhammad I's son and successor, Muhammad II al-Faqih struck a deal with Alfonso X, paying the Castilian king some 300,000 maravedis and promising not to intrigue with Castilian rebels. But Alfonso X did not fulfill his side of the agreement and continued his support for the Ashqilula, so Muhammad II renewed his request to the Marinids for assistance, offering them the Iberian towns of Tarifa, Algeciras and Ronda as payment.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subject: Indian Languages
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subSubject: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.question: With Morocco now pacified and _____ controlled, in April 1275, Abu Yusuf Yaqub took up the Nasrid request and crossed the straits, landing a large Moroccan army in Spain
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: But the Marinid emir Abu Yusuf was then engaged against Tlemcen and could not intervene. With Morocco now pacified and Tlemcen controlled, in April 1275, Abu Yusuf Yaqub took up the Nasrid request and crossed the straits, landing a large Moroccan army in Spain.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subject: Indian Languages
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subSubject: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: The Marinids defeated the Castilians at the Battle of Algeciras on 21 July 1279, and forced Alfonso X to lift the siege and withdraw.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subject: Indian Languages
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subSubject: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: The Marinids defeated the Castilians at the Battle of Algeciras on 21 July 1279, and forced Alfonso X to lift the siege and withdraw. But no sooner had the Castilian threat receded, that Abu Yusuf and Muhammad II fell into a quarrel over whom exactly held suzerain title over Algeciras and Málaga.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subject: Indian Languages
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subSubject: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.question: Now it was the turn of the _____ to forge an alliance with Alfonso X of Castile
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: The Marinids defeated the Castilians at the Battle of Algeciras on 21 July 1279, and forced Alfonso X to lift the siege and withdraw. Now it was the turn of the Marinids to forge an alliance with Alfonso X of Castile.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.subject: Indian Languages

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.question: The Marinids supported Castilian raids against Granada in _____ and 1281
Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: The Marinids supported Castilian raids against Granada in 1280 and 1281.

For his part, Muhammad II al-Faqih of Granada turned to Peter III of Aragon and Alfonso X's estranged son, the infante Sancho.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: At Alfonso X's request, Abu Yusuf crossed the straits for the third time in July, 1282.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Abd al-Haqq.fact: Nothing much came of this campaign, and the Marinids returned to Morocco soon after, with little to show for their efforts. In Granada, the Banu Ashqilula, under a renewed Nasrid assault, had also appealed to the Marinids.

Al-Masudi.fact: Everything the ancient Greeks had brought to light vanished, and the discoveries of the ancients were altered beyond recognition.
